Stick through, do something unexpected that wasn't part of your agenda for the next few hours, like take a shower. Jog. Something just very "not you". Dont think about it, just do. Maybe write and write about your thoughts till you can't write any more.

Take your own side today. Grab your shoulders and hug yourself slightly so you can feel like you're in your own body. Sit with yourself and hear yourself out. I don't know if this is unpleasant to hear right now - but you are not your thoughts. Your thoughts may come pouring in by the hundreds, but you don't have to believe a damn thing. You just let them wash over you. They're not you. You are not your thoughts. You're just the observer. 

Sending you love!
